ci.assertion: the v2 generation must be live first

diagnosis: The initial credential-refresh worker can run before start_slot publishes its generation in the state map. An immediately due credential observes no active generation and returns. Readiness then reports a dead critical task and the supervisor rebuilds before the intended broker refusal.
change: A one-shot install notification gates the real credential-refresh worker. Publication releases it; a cancelled install drops the sender and the candidate worker exits. Existing generation cancellation, cleanup ownership, expiry and protocol policy are unchanged.
testChanges: No original test assertions, platform gates, time budgets or fixture protocol changed. The Desktop unit-test adapter explicitly uses already-installed generations.
localAuthorization: User explicitly requested local testing after repair and before the next CI run. This authorizes the bounded real-process integration rerun; earlier zero-local-test records remain historical.

targeted.command: cargo test --offline --locked --no-default-features --features headless --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test remote_start_refusal a_reconnect_with_a_pre_v2_slot_forgets_it -- --exact --nocapture

limits: Local macOS verification does not establish Linux or Windows acceptance.
No final future headless CLI integration migration, release or manual acceptance is claimed.
These local warm-cache timings are provenance, not a matched performance comparison.
